text:
maya: Heads up — I noticed ~120 invoices for April show $0 usage line items in Stripe but net revenue on our end looks fine.
oliver: hmm, do you mean the usage records didn't attach, or Stripe shows $0 amount on the invoice PDF?
maya: Stripe invoice line shows 0.00 for 'API calls (units)'. Charges are present elsewhere (card payments). arjun: can you paste the invoice id? maya: inv_3Kabc... (truncated) — I pulled inv_3KabcD from logs.
finance-bot: nightly-sync: stripe->ns sync completed with 2 warnings, 1 failed job. See /jobs/stripe-ns/2026-04-01
oliver: could be our webhook consumer skipping lines due to missing idempotency token on retry. We recently changed the consumer to be stateless.
maya: We also had a burst of replays around 03:12 UTC (SQS requeues). I see a 409 on retry in the logs: "Duplicate invoice line - no-op" arjun: that 409 path may result in an invoice being created without usage lines if the line creation fails mid-transaction.
maya: here's the relevant snippet from the webhook handler logs:
```
2026-04-01T03:12:04Z INFO webhookHandler processing invoice.created payload for cus_123
2026-04-01T03:12:04Z ERROR usage-attach failed: Missing idempotency-key header
2026-04-01T03:12:05Z INFO invoice created (partial): id=inv_3KabcD
2026-04-01T03:12:06Z WARN retry enqueued
```
oliver: oh — the client that sends usage attach requests relies on an internal idempotency token we strip in the consumer. We switched proxy versions last week.
arjun: quick check — do we have a compensating reconcile that runs? I think the nightly 'usage-attach' job should patch invoices, but if invoice.created was processed and later reconciler sees invoice.amount=0 it should trigger attachment.
maya: The nightly job ran but failed for 2 customers (same ones) with DB deadlock during batched writes. That explains why some were left broken.
oliver: OK action plan: 1) re-run usage-attach backfill for affected invoices (non-destructive), 2) add idempotency propagation in the consumer proxy, 3) harden nightly job with row-level retry instead of batch FAIL.
arjun: Agree. Also add a guard: if invoice.amount>0 in Stripe but no usage lines attached in NetSuite mapping, log an alert to #billing-ops.
maya: I'll kick off a targeted backfill now for inv_3KabcD and a small set.
finance-bot: backfill job started: job_id=bf_20260401_01, expected duration ~18m
deploy-bot: Deploy completed: proxy v2.14.1 -> added header passthrough for Idempotency-Key
oliver: after backfill completes, let's run a quick reconcile sweep and mark tickets for any remaining orphaned invoices.
maya: Backfill finished — attached usage lines for 107 invoices, 13 still failed due to NS mapping errors (missing tax code). Filing follow-up with @arjun.
arjun: I'll take the 13 mapping errors. Suspect taxcode lookup failed because customer region was blank in profile.
maya: Thanks. I'll update the incident log and create a short postmortem draft.
oliver: :thumbsup: good triage. Let's also add a metric to track invoices created with partial data (counter labeled invoice.partial_created).
finance-bot: incident created: INC-2026-117 (partial invoices after webhook replay)
maya: filing the postmortem draft at /docs/incidents/INC-2026-117-draft.md — ping me if you want to add details.
